summary: SmoothQuant (Xiao et al.): training-free post-training W8A8 quantization for LLMs. Weights are easy to quantize and activations are not, because of activation outliers; SmoothQuant migrates that difficulty from activations to weights with a mathematically equivalent per-channel scaling, enabling INT8 weights and activations for every matmul (OPT, BLOOM, GLM, MT-NLG, Llama-1/2, Falcon, Mistral, Mixtral) with up to 1.56x speedup, 2x memory reduction and negligible accuracy loss.
note: GPU measurements; the smoothing transform itself is hardware-independent. Indexed after the gemma-4-31B-it hill-climb on v6e-8 lost accuracy (5 of 200 multiplication probes) to per-token dynamic int8 activations, and found no source on activation outliers.
verified_from: summary and keywords checked against the arXiv abstract page (2211.10438) on 2026-10-09

summary: LLM.int8() (Dettmers et al.): Int8 matmul for transformer feed-forward and attention projections that halves inference memory without degradation up to 175B parameters. Vector-wise quantization (a normalization constant per inner product) covers most features; the systematic emergent outlier feature dimensions are split into a 16-bit matmul (mixed-precision decomposition) while over 99.9% of values stay 8-bit.
note: GPU work. Why per-token int8 activations lose accuracy on large models: a few feature dimensions carry outliers that one scale per token cannot represent.
